memory_budget.name: memory_budget
memory_budget.info: the logical memory budget used to size caches and buffers. 0 targets 80% of cgroup or physical memory while reserving at least 1G for the system when possible. The minimum automatic value is 1G. Range: 0, [1G,).

kvcache_memory_limit.name: kvcache_memory_limit
kvcache_memory_limit.info: the maximum memory used by KV cache. 0 derives the limit from memory_budget. The automatic value is min(1T, 40% of memory_budget). A dynamic increase cannot exceed the capacity reserved at startup. Range: [0M,1T].

cpu_count.name: cpu_count
cpu_count.info: the number of CPU\'s in the system. If this parameter is set to zero, the number will be set according to sysconf; otherwise, this parameter is used. Range: [0,+∞) in integer

memstore_memory_limit.name: memstore_memory_limit
memstore_memory_limit.info: the maximum memory used by Memstore. 0 derives the limit from memory_budget. The automatic value is 50% of memory_budget. Range: [0M,).
